For each \(k\), \(f(k,6)=\binom{5}{k-1}\), so the favorable count is
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{6} \binom{5}{k-1}6^{6-k}
=6^5+5\cdot6^4+10\cdot6^3+10\cdot6^2+5\cdot6+1
=16807=7^5.
\]
Total sequences:
\[
6^6=46656.
\]
Thus
\[
p=\frac{7^5}{6^6},
\]
so \(m=6^6\), \(n=7^5\). Therefore
\[
\log_6 m-\log_7 n=6-5=1.
\]
\[
\boxed{1}
\]
